cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: A quiet dining alcove in a medieval river inn with a lamp on the table and a dark gothic window — She has ordered a whole spiced orange and watches the rising steam after opening its shell; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a Guan Yu temple — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a convention photo zone under ring lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — sets a small hand lantern down on the ground beside her; a misty enchanted garden of moss — lying on her front; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — standing; a self-service car wash bay — standing; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — chest-deep in the water; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — holds a sketchbook and pencil out at arm's length to look over the finished sketch; a neon-lit game arcade — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder
